从相加和相减两块元件起步，亲手搭出算得更多的元件。: Starting from Add and Subtract, build parts that work out more yourself.
每块元件只算两个数，怎样算更多的数？: Each part works on two numbers: how do you work on more?
一个数减去另一个数的结果。: What taking one number from another gives.
给出两个输入之和；只要有一个输入为「—」，就给出「—」。: Gives the sum of its two inputs; gives 「—」 if either input is 「—」.
给出第一个输入减去第二个输入的差；只要有一个输入为「—」，就给出「—」。: Gives its first input less its second; gives 「—」 if either input is 「—」.
板左边是这一关给的三个数，右边是要交出的结果。手上的两块元件各算两个数：一块求和: The three numbers this level gives are on the left of the board, the result to give on the right. The two parts at hand each work on two numbers: one gives their sum, the other their <wiki-ref to="difference"></wiki-ref>.
给出 a 加 b、再减去 c 的结果。: Gives a plus b, less c.
交出 a 加 b、再减去 c 的结果。: Give a plus b, less c.
一块元件的输出可以接到另一块元件的输入上。: One part’s output can go into another part’s input.
这一关给的数多了两个。: This level gives two more numbers.
交出 a + b − c + d − e。: Give a + b − c + d − e.
